semantics.relativePosition: Where the territory sits among this candidate set: the median, over panels, of its rank percentile in one same-call rank of territory exemplars for the brand. Rank-only; raw values are never compared across calls.
semantics.representationRobustness: Whether that position survives swapping the territory's exemplars (rule-based HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW/INSUFFICIENT; not a probability).
semantics.culturalCoherence: Which tag signals the brand and each territory exemplar share, by set membership only, in a RAW and an operational-filtered view. Explanatory; not used to classify.
semantics.evidenceQuality: Whether the evidence packets are technically trustworthy and complete (Sprint 1 Cultural Evidence Core). Independent of robustness.
semantics.classification: Relative to the comparison set; PROVISIONAL thresholds. Grid search on calibration brands (jacquemus, muji, alienware); evaluated on held-out brands (patagonia, lululemon, nintendo). Provisional: 3 + 3 brands is too few to validate thresholds.

classificationPolicy.basis: Grid search on calibration brands (jacquemus, muji, alienware); evaluated on held-out brands (patagonia, lululemon, nintendo). Provisional: 3 + 3 brands is too few to validate thresholds.

indexDecision.basis: Sprint 2 live benchmark (6 brands, captured 2026-10-16): the index gate failed for 6/6 brands. Check B (alternate-exemplar panels agree on territory order, Kendall τ ≥ 0.6) failed for every brand (per-brand minimum τ 0.07–0.47); check C (no single panel moves a median by more than one rank step) failed for 5/6. Repeats (A), monotonicity (D), missing-evidence (E), quality visibility (F) and reconstruction (G) passed for all. A 0–100 number would hide exemplar sensitivity, so the product reports relative position + robustness + coherence + classification instead.

summary.text:
For Rapha, within the comparison set of cycling, mountaineering and coffee, coffee holds the first relative position and cycling the last, with mountaineering in the middle. All three territories show low robustness, and the coffee and cycling classes are provisional and relative only to this set. The evidence cannot establish a stable ranking or describe how these associations relate to any audience outcome.
Coffee: Coffee ranks first of three in the comparison set, but its robustness is low, so this ordering is not treated as stable. Coffee is provisionally classed as uncertain and representation-sensitive, relative only to the cycling, mountaineering and coffee comparison set. The brand-conditioned Qloo results for coffee are supported and include Black Bird Bookstore and Café and Stumptown Coffee Roasters, though the list is truncated.
Mountaineering: Mountaineering sits in the middle of the three in the comparison set, without a clear lead over the other territories. Robustness for mountaineering is low, so its middle position is not treated as stable. Evidence quality for mountaineering is low and coherence was not collected, so shared cultural signals cannot be read for this territory.
Cycling: Cycling ranks last of three in this comparison set, relative only to the mountaineering and coffee territories shown. Cycling is provisionally classed as uncertain and representation-sensitive within this set, and its place panel is small. The brand-conditioned results for cycling are supported and lead with Lambeth Bridge and Hampstead Heath, though the list is truncated.

followUpOptions: Add further place exemplars for cycling and coffee to test whether the representation-sensitive classes hold.
Run mountaineering with additional exemplars such as Half Dome or Ben Nevis to see whether its relative position becomes more consistent.
Bring in a reference territory from outside this comparison set to give the three territories a wider frame.
Repeat the brand-conditioned query for coffee and cycling by entity type, such as cafés or bookstores, to check whether the top entities persist.

agentInterpretation.summary:
For Rapha, within the comparison set of cycling, mountaineering and coffee, coffee holds the first relative position and cycling the last, with mountaineering in the middle. All three territories show low robustness, and the coffee and cycling classes are provisional and relative only to this set. The evidence cannot establish a stable ranking or describe how these associations relate to any audience outcome.
Coffee: Coffee ranks first of three in the comparison set, but its robustness is low, so this ordering is not treated as stable. Coffee is provisionally classed as uncertain and representation-sensitive, relative only to the cycling, mountaineering and coffee comparison set. The brand-conditioned Qloo results for coffee are supported and include Black Bird Bookstore and Café and Stumptown Coffee Roasters, though the list is truncated.
Mountaineering: Mountaineering sits in the middle of the three in the comparison set, without a clear lead over the other territories. Robustness for mountaineering is low, so its middle position is not treated as stable. Evidence quality for mountaineering is low and coherence was not collected, so shared cultural signals cannot be read for this territory.
Cycling: Cycling ranks last of three in this comparison set, relative only to the mountaineering and coffee territories shown. Cycling is provisionally classed as uncertain and representation-sensitive within this set, and its place panel is small. The brand-conditioned results for cycling are supported and lead with Lambeth Bridge and Hampstead Heath, though the list is truncated.
